from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class HousingDataPoint(BaseModel):
    """A single monthly SAAR data point extracted from a housing construction report."""
    month: str = Field(description="The month of the data point, formatted as YYYY-MM")
    saar_value: float = Field(description="The SAAR value for housing starts. The parser should normalize this to thousands of units (e.g. 565.0 means 565,000)")
    value_unit: str = Field(description="The original unit scale found in the document text (e.g. 'thousands', 'units')")
    report_release_date: str = Field(description="The date the report was released, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD. Used to determine precedence for conflicting values.")
    region: str = Field(description="The geographic region covered by this data point")
    building_category: str = Field(description="The building type category covered by this data point (e.g. 'five or more units')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    data_points: list[HousingDataPoint]
